line.comment: 1.211 em line box. Room above the cap height holds two stacked Vietnamese marks (Ế, Ổ) without clipping; win metrics are taken from real glyph bounds at build time.

curves.comment: Tension measured against the tangent intersection; 0.5523 is a true circle. Outer curves are a touch firmer than circular and counters follow them a hair rounder, so the stroke keeps its weight round the bowl instead of thinning at the diagonals.

Light.comment: Light from the Regular -> Light change measured on SF Pro (opsz 17) and Inter (opsz 14) at 300/400 (rasters, x-height normalised; Helvetica Light sits near 200 and is left out). Unlike Bold, Light is not on the Regular -> Bold line: SF and Inter thin horizontals as much as verticals (contrast kept) and keep advances (x0.98-1.00), so the counters open. Strokes: stems x0.78 (cap stem x0.76, figure stem x0.77), round sides x0.77, round tops x0.78, arch x0.79, bars x0.77, e bar x0.79, diagonals x0.81; marks and punctuation thin with the stem (x0.78). Widths: Regular + g x (Light - Regular stem), g = SF/Inter mean per shape (n 0.55, m 0.65, o 0.5, c 0.7, e 0.4, a 0.8, d 0.65, s 0.75, r 0.85, t 1.0, f 1.0, v 0.8, w 0.4, x 0.55, y 0.85, z 0.6, k 1.3, H 0.8, N 0.55, M 0.75, U 0.65, J 0.6, K 1.2, E F 0.6, L 0.5, T 0.45, Z 0.6, B 0.75, P 0.9, R 0.95, D 0.55, O 0.5, G 0.55, C 0.4, S 0.7, A V 0.7, W 0.8, X 0.85, Y 0.7, figure 0.5); tabular advance x0.995. Sidebearings x1.06. Dots shrink less than stems (dot/stem x1.12), mark dots x1.05, mark width x0.94. Apertures as measured: c opens x1.11 (terminals x1.11), e x1.18 (lower terminal 0.485), figures and ? barely (terminalClose -0.005); C a s S keep their Regular cuts (G shares C's cut and stays, where SF/Inter open it x1.08).

Bold.comment: Derived from Regular by the Regular→Bold change measured on SF Pro, Inter and Helvetica rasters (x-height units): stems ×1.62, round sides ×1.65, round tops and shoulders ×1.45, capital bars ×1.49, lowercase bars ×1.36, diagonals ×1.6, marks ×1.35. Body width = Regular + g × added stem weight, g per letter shape from the mean of SF and Inter (n 1.0, o 0.6, d 0.75, H 0.75, O 0.45 …). Sidebearings ×0.85.

instances.comment: Weights between the masters are interpolated from the masters' own parameters, not drawn: every stroke, shape, proportion, spacing and curve value is Regular + t (Bold - Regular) with t = (wght - 400) / (700 - 400), and the same recipes run on the result. SF and Inter put 500 at t 0.29-0.38 on every measured stroke, aperture and advance (rasters, x-height normalised), i.e. linear in wght, so Medium uses t = 1/3. Medium also serves CSS weight 600 (UI semibold): declare its face as font-weight 500 600, otherwise browsers pick Bold for 600. Strokes, widths and spacing round to whole units, shapes to 4 decimals.

shapes.comment: Ratios: bar heights are fractions of cap/x-height, join heights fractions of x-height, terminal cuts fractions of the bowl radius from its centre. a: aHookLeft is a fraction of the letter width, aBowlCorner of the bowl width, aBowlSlope is in degrees.

proportions.comment: Body widths (outer extremes, font units) at Regular. n:o:H:O = 0.77 : 0.88 : 1 : 1.16.

spacing.comment: Sidebearings by edge shape. Round = 0.63 x straight, diagonal = 0.1 x straight; terminals sit between. Bowls 0.57 x straight, open arms/bars/hooks by the white they enclose.

identity.rule: Every terminal is cut exactly horizontal (c, e, s, a, 2) or exactly vertical (r, t, 1). No diagonal or rounded ends.

Bowls use tension 0.59 outside and 0.58 inside (circle = 0.552): the counter follows the outline, so the stroke keeps 0.94 of its side weight at the diagonals; apertures close like SF (c 0.39 x-height) and s has a shallow spine, so letters read as round forms, not pen strokes.

Shoulders and bowls leave the stem high and steep (0.88 x-height, 76°); the n counter meets the stem at 0.65 x-height, where SF, Inter and Be Vietnam Pro put it (0.65–0.67), so the counter stays round and the notch reads at 11–13 px without a pen-like wedge.

identity.trait: Vietnamese marks drawn in the same pen
identity.rule: Marks share one stroke (markStroke 158) and the full-round curve and sit 152 units over the x-height; after a circumflex the acute, grave and hook rise from 92 % of its height on its upper right with a solved 44-unit clearance; the horn is a level shelf turning into an upright stub cut horizontally at 1.24 x-height.
